title: A manager invites a new hire, who claims the code and sees their published shift

backendBuild.detail: the in-repo fixture backend, not an API build (branch lane/wf-invite-pair-fe)

steps.name: sign in as the manager on the roster
the new hire is on the roster and has no login
steps.detail: Ingen innlogging er koblet til engasjementet ennå. Personen kan settes opp på vakter, men kan ikke logge inn og se dem.

steps.name: the panel no longer claims it cannot list or revoke
steps.detail: no absence claimed; the list reads EMPTY for an uninvited hire

steps.name: the handover names the address and admits nothing was sent
steps.detail: no delivery channel, /workforce/join named, once-only stated

steps.name: turn the schedule publication switch on for this store
build and publish a week containing the new hire's shift
a fragment-carried code never reaches the address bar
paste the real code BEFORE signing in
steps.detail: code accepted, page asks for a sign-in

steps.name: sign in as the new hire, in place
steps.detail: signed in without navigating; the pasted code survived

steps.name: the page admits what it cannot tell them before the button
steps.detail: Dette vet vi ikke ennå Vi kan ikke vise hvilken arbeidsplass koden gjelder, hvilken rolle du får ell…

steps.name: claim the code
steps.detail: claimed; grants on the receipt: WorkforceSelf

steps.name: the worker sees the shift the manager published
steps.detail: first shift card: 09:00–15:00 Uten rolle Betalt tid 6t Fra publisering 1

steps.name: claiming the same code again is answered honestly, not as a bare error
steps.detail: opaque refusal + the account's own engagements shown beside it

steps.name: the manager's roster now reads the person as signed in
steps.detail: Denne personen har koblet en innlogging til engasjementet og kan bruke Min vaktplan.
